headline: Dolomite protocol across 7 chains: core immutable contracts, module layers, router contracts, and token deployments catalogued from official documentation and audited repository.

findings.text: Block explorer searches on Arbitrum (arbiscan.io) yielded DolomiteMargin primary contract at 0x6bd780e7fdf01d77e4d475c821f1e7ae05409072 with label 'Dolomite: Margin 1'

Official deployed addresses documentation at docs.dolomite.io/smart-contract-addresses lists Core Immutable, Core Proxies, and Core Routers across Arbitrum One, Base, Berachain, Ink, Mantle, Polygon zkEVM, X Layer; specific router addresses documented for BorrowPositionRouter (0xF579b345cdA0860668b857De10ABD62442133D0F), DepositWithdrawalRouter (0xf8b2c637A68cF6A17b1DF9F8992EeBeFf63d2dFf), and GenericTraderRouter (0x7b61CbA306CfdB02493b94757143132B1b72Bc6b)

Two audit reports accessed: SECBIT Labs audit dated 2021-08-02 for DolomiteMargin protocol modifications; Cyfrin audit link confirmed in GitHub repository; website lists six auditors (Zeppelin Solutions, Bramah Systems, SECBIT Labs, Cyfrin, Zokyo, Guardian) with 100% code coverage

GitHub repository dolomite-exchange/dolomite-margin contains source contracts and deployment configurations; repository structure includes migrations/, contracts/, and scripts/ directories typical of Foundry/Truffle deployments; v2 branch is primary deployment target

Multi-chain deployment confirmed across 7 chains per protocol specification: Ethereum, Arbitrum, Berachain, Mantle, Polygon zkEVM, X Layer, and Botanix (Spiderchain). Each chain has separate Core Immutable, Proxy, and Module contract instances.

Factory pattern not applicable to DolomiteMargin primary protocol; Markets are enumerated by numerical ID referenced in Market struct; no factory-based child contract enumeration observed in core architecture.

Role taxonomy identified: admin (Owner/Admin role for protocol governance), proxy_admin (Core Proxy contracts subject to modifications via owner calls), router (BorrowPositionRouter, DepositWithdrawalRouter, GenericTraderRouter for operation routing), timelock (inferred from admin privilege structure), guardian (inferred from liquidation control logic), and token (DOLO governance token)

Addresses sourced from three primary fetched documents: (1) GitHub repository documentation and code, (2) Official docs.dolomite.io smart contract addresses pages, (3) Arbiscan block explorer verified contract pages. All links are internally consistent across sources.

rationale.verdict: Discovery phase catalogued Dolomite protocol contracts across 7 deployed chains via official documentation (docs.dolomite.io), GitHub repository (dolomite-exchange/dolomite-margin), and block explorer verification (Arbitrum). Core architecture separates immutable core layer from mutable module layer with explicit router contracts for operations. Six independent audits documented with 100% test coverage. Specific contract addresses extracted for routers and primary margin contracts; multi-chain deployment requires per-chain address enumeration documented in official source.

protocol_metadata.about: Dolomite is a next-generation lending and margin trading protocol supporting over 1,000 unique assets through a modular architecture separating an immutable core layer from mutable module layers. Users can deposit collateral, borrow against diverse assets, and execute margin trades with virtual liquidity while retaining control via isolated positions. The protocol operates across 7 EVM-compatible chains including Arbitrum, Berachain, Polygon zkEVM, and Bitcoin's Spiderchain, offering capital efficiency through internal liquidity recycling and innovative yield strategies.
